earlier_scan.source_named: Trovina R. P. E. Walangara 2003. Verba Bahasa Anakalang, 62 pp. (Glottolog Glottolog's most extensive description, doctype phonology or text collection); Indonesian thesis not found online.

sources.citation: Djawa, Alex; Labu Djuli; Markus Sampe. 2022. Suprasegmental phonemics in Anakalang language in Central Sumba District. Academic Journal of Educational Sciences (AJES, Universitas Nusa Cendana) 6(1): 107-111. DOI 10.35508/ajes.v6i1.7593.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Read in full (5 pp.). Despite the title, it contains NO statement on word-stress position. 'Stress/pressure' (tekanan) is used only for a 'strong vs weak' articulation of stops in minimal pairs (bali 'ball' vs ƀali 'go home', tada 'kick' vs tađa 'sign', dedi vs đeđi), i.e. the plain-voiced vs implosive/'muted' stop contrast, e.g. p.109: 'The difference in meaning of the two words is not marked by a difference in sound/letter, but is indicated by a soft/weak and strong stress when the sound is pronounced.' Nothing on syllable prominence, penult, etc.

sources.citation: Djawa, Alex; Simon Sabon Ola; Felysianus Sanga. 2020. Verba dalam bahasa Anakalang. Jurnal Lazuardi 3(3). DOI 10.53441/jl.vol3.iss3.43.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Verb morphology/morphophonemics; a full-text search for stress/accent tekanan/aksen/stress/suku kata: nothing on stress.

sources.citation: Djawa, Alex; Felysianus Sanga; Kosmos Jeladu; I Nyoman Reteg. 2019. Klitik pronomina dalam bahasa Anakalang. Jurnal Lazuardi 2(2): 153-170. DOI 10.53441/jl.vol2.iss2.7.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Morphology of pronominal clitics; only a generic textbook definition that clitics 'tidak dapat diberi aksen atau tekanan apa-apa' (cannot bear accent/stress). No Anakalang stress rule.

sources.citation: Budasi, I G. 2012. Phonological evidences which separate and unite Mamboro language from Proto Wanokaka-Anakalang in Sumba group of languages. k@ta 14(2) (pp. 67-74). DOI 10.9744/kata.14.2.67-74. (via CORE 132131542 / Neliti 147254)
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)

sources.citation: Budasi, I Gede. 2010. Bukti-bukti leksikal pembeda bahasa Wanokaka dan Anakalang di Sumba NTT. Mabasan 4(1): 24-42. DOI 10.26499/mab.v4i1.184.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Historical-comparative lexical evidence (Proto Wanokaka-Anakalang); 'penultima/ultima' appear only as positions of sound correspondences (b : implosive, s : h). No stress statement.
